name: Table
description: Table is a low-level primitive for rendering semantic HTML tables with consistent styling and theming. It always renders a native <table> element and exposes props for layout (auto or fixed), borders, zebra striping, and sticky headers. Use it with companion components (TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableCell, etc.) to build accessible, fully-customizable tabular layouts.

props.name: layout
props.description: Table layout algorithm; maps to CSS table-layout

props.name: zebra
props.description: Adds row striping via data attribute

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Makes header sticky (requires a set height/overflow on the container)

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Wraps the table in a scroll container when true

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width of the table, useful to trigger horizontal scrolling in fixed layout.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the box surface (e.g. solid, outline)

props.name: intent
props.description: Semantic tone or purpose (e.g. neutral, success, danger)
